author: Yes Theory
description:
This episode of Abandoned in pushes us past our comfort zones in every way - and we partnered with Brooks Running to help us take that leap. The Brooks Glycerin Flex is built for softness and support when you’re stepping into the unknown, physically or mentally.

Get yours here: https://www.brooksrunning.com/en_us/featured/glycerin/mens/?tid=inf:yt:mega:targeted:Pm1x:USA:YesTheory

Thank you to the incredible @AnnaCramling for being such a champion. After years, she finally proved that a Yes Theory challenge, with the right energy, intention and of course mindful precautions, is in fact available to all. Hope you all enjoyed this wild ride :)

Thank you to https://www.youtube.com/@thehumanchris/ for having helped us capture this experience.

Who are we? 
We believe life’s greatest moments and deepest connections exist outside your comfort zone.

🙏🏼 Thank you for making these videos possible through your support of Seek Discomfort 
⚡️ SEEK DISCOMFORT: http://seek-discomfort.com/yes-the
